title: DeGlobal
tagline: ethglobal but decentralized via attestations and index onchain
description:
ethglobal is a centralized platform but it should be open for anyone to run their own hackathon in a decentralized manner on chain.
ui can still be proprietary to ethglobal, but index itself must be decentralized where anyone can create it in a no code way, announce the hackathon and attestation model and have everything on chain
how_its_made: ethglobal should operate on the proof of project where github is attested onchain and it is indexed with a custom index so anyone can issue attestations and then set up a no code index to run a hackathon and judge. every proof of project can be attested as a winning one and rewarded on chain
